operations.name: Saw Tube Blanks
operations.setup_note: Support and clamp the tube without crushing it, and saw individual 99 mm blanks with facing allowance at both ends.

operations.name: CNC Turn – Reference Face and Bore
operations.setup_note: Grip a short OD band in conforming soft jaws at low pressure, leaving clearance for through-boring, and face the exposed end as the axial setup reference. Rough the accessible OD before boring, then finish the through bore while retaining OD finishing stock.

operations.name: CNC Turn – Final Length and OD
operations.setup_note: Locate on the finished bore using a low-pressure expanding mandrel against the first machined face, with a relieved stop providing tool clearance at both OD rims. Face the opposite end to final length, rough the former grip band, then finish the complete OD and chamfer both ends without reloading.

operations.name: Deburr and Clean
operations.setup_note: Support the released tube on a non-marring bench fixture and remove residual burrs, limiting unspecified edge breaks to 0.5 mm maximum. Clean the bore and exterior without altering the specified chamfers or finished dimensions.

operations.name: Final Dimensional Inspection
operations.setup_note: Inspect each clean part unclamped and temperature-stabilized, checking OD, bore size at multiple axial and angular positions, overall length, both chamfers, and the specified OD finish. Verify the bore remains within limits after release from the mandrel.

clarifications.question: What commercially available seamless tube blank size is approved with sufficient guaranteed cleanup on both finished diameters?
clarifications.suggested_default: Use the provisional 155.0 mm OD × 141.7 mm ID tube, cut to 99.0 mm, only after procurement verifies availability and dimensional tolerances that guarantee cleanup.

clarifications.question: Are the specified 1–1.5 mm × 45° chamfers located on the outside rims at both ends?
clarifications.suggested_default: Apply one specified chamfer to each OD rim; break the bore edges to 0.5 mm maximum.

assumptions.text: The route is for part 080300: overall length is 93.17–93.67 mm and the variant table states PROCESS PER: NONE. Requirements for parts 080301 and 080302 are not applied.

Near-net seamless mechanical tubing within the stated material range is assumed available. The selected tube dimensions are provisional purchasing targets, not a verified commercial standard size; actual stock tolerances must guarantee complete cleanup.

The 0.3 mm machining allowance is interpreted as a nominal diametral finishing allowance for this near-net tube. Light roughing removes the supplied surface before finishing; no bulk OD or bore removal is assumed.
No drawing datum letters are supplied. The first machined end and finished bore are manufacturing locating references only, so datum_references remains empty.
Both end-facing cuts target F02 because its axial length defines the overall length and the routing view contains no separate end-face feature IDs.

F04 is provisionally interpreted as two OD chamfers. Its two instances receive separate chamfer-turning sub-operations, and the specific chamfer dimensions override the general 0.5 mm maximum edge break.

The expanding mandrel and relieved axial stop are assumed available or procurable. The accessible OD is roughed before boring; the original grip band is roughed in the second lathe setup, and all OD finishing follows bore finishing to control thin-wall distortion.

Center drilling and tailstock support are omitted because this is a short, open-bore tube. Pilot drilling is omitted because the stock already has a through bore; grooving and threading are omitted because no such features are specified; parting off is omitted because individual blanks are saw-cut and both ends are faced.
